{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies UniValue, the core JSON parser used across the RPC interface.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents out-of-bounds memory reads during JSON tokenization of keywords and number prefixes when input buffers lack null termination. While RPC inputs are often null-terminated in practice, memory safety defects in the request parser present stability risks for the node's programmatic interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/fuzz/parse_univalue.cpp and src/univalue/test/ files only to test the univalue bounds-checking fix.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test adjustments and fuzz harness updates directly follow from the tokenizer fix and do not alter shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies files under src/univalue/, which is explicitly covered as a vendored subtree under utilities.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes two out-of-bounds read vulnerabilities in UniValue's JSON tokenizer by respecting the explicit end pointer. Resolves #28260 by replacing unsafe `strncmp` keyword matching and unchecked digit reads on truncated buffer slices."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
